reply.analysis: Proven: the bracket is [455, 455]. The lower bound is an independent set of size 455, and the upper bound is a linear code over F_2 with c=1. All four checks passed: independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding. The agent took 102.2 s wall (32.4 s LLM, 69.8 s compute, 2 LLM calls, 1 critic round) and tried one code. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha also found 455 but did not prove it, in 123 s. CP-SAT cover returned no value and fractional cover gave 1800 unproven. F2 minrank SAT reached only 454 in 1.2 s. The rule-based kushagra_agent reached 455/455 exactly in 1.9 s, so it was much faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious. The only oddity is that the solver's evidence line calls 530 a gap, but the final bracket closed.
